sections.heading: Zhalia's Strix
sections.text:
In Prague, two Strix were invoked by Zhalia Moon to defeat two Redcaps. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies] In the Paris Catacombs, Zhalia invoked three Strix to defeat two Mindrone Titans and a Jokoul Titan. [Divide and Conquer]

In Iceland, Zhalia invoked her Strix to put holes in the clouds, allowing the sun's light to come through and make the Rainbow Bridge. [The Legacy of Thor] In the Temple of Thor, Zhalia later invoked one Strix to help distract the Guardians of Thor. [Two Powers Become One]

On Madea Island, an illusion of Strix was invoked by an illusion of Zhalia but was defeated by Sophie's Sabriel. [The Beautiful Trap]

At the Temple of Poseidon, Zhalia invoked two Strix to make holes in the gliders of Rassimov's Suits. [The Unseen Guide]

sections.heading: Suits' Strix
sections.wikitext:
In the [[Cave of the Gargoyle]], Strix Titans were used by the [[Organization]] in the battle against the Huntik team. {{Source|Into the River of Secrets}}

A Strix was invoked by [[Alpha]], one of [[the Professor]]'s Suits. It attacked [[Lok]]'s [[Freelancer]] and Zhalia's [[Kilthane]] but was defeated by [[Cherit]]. {{Source|The Divine Comedy}}

sections.heading: Design History
sections.wikitext:
''Strix is a horrible flying insect Titan with a long sting that he uses to hit his enemies when moving at top speed. The idea was that a Seeker could summon a swarm of Strix Titans, and though individually they are very weak, together they can defeat a much stronger Titan. The early sketch shows Strix looking a lot like a mosquito, with a small head and a long skinny body. Over time, this changed to a fatter body and shorter neck so it would be easier to see on the television. It also has a stinger on its tail as well as its long tongue, so a Strix is dangerous on both ends!'' {{source|Huntik.com}}

full_text:
Strix are pesky, mosquito-like Swara-Titans. These Titans are common and require very little energy for a Seeker to invoke, so they are often summoned in groups of two or three from a single Amulet.

History

The ancient Romans believed that Strix were evil humans who had been cursed and transformed into vampires. [Huntik.com] In the modern age, Strix became a common Titan used by the agents of the Organization. [Huntik.com]

Zhalia's Strix

In Prague, two Strix were invoked by Zhalia Moon to defeat two Redcaps. [Words of Truth, Heart of Lies] In the Paris Catacombs, Zhalia invoked three Strix to defeat two Mindrone Titans and a Jokoul Titan. [Divide and Conquer]

In Iceland, Zhalia invoked her Strix to put holes in the clouds, allowing the sun's light to come through and make the Rainbow Bridge. [The Legacy of Thor] In the Temple of Thor, Zhalia later invoked one Strix to help distract the Guardians of Thor. [Two Powers Become One]

On Madea Island, an illusion of Strix was invoked by an illusion of Zhalia but was defeated by Sophie's Sabriel. [The Beautiful Trap]

At the Temple of Poseidon, Zhalia invoked two Strix to make holes in the gliders of Rassimov's Suits. [The Unseen Guide]

Suits' Strix

In the Cave of the Gargoyle, Strix Titans were used by the Organization in the battle against the Huntik team. [Into the River of Secrets]

A Strix was invoked by Alpha, one of the Professor's Suits. It attacked Lok's Freelancer and Zhalia's Kilthane but was defeated by Cherit. [The Divine Comedy]

Dante's Strix

At some point, Dante Vale acquired a Strix Amulet. It was seen amongst his collection of Titans when he retrieved his Ignatius Amulet from a drawer. [S1E07]

Stack's Strix

On Avalon, Stack invoked three Strix to attack the Huntik team but they were defeated by Dante's Caliban. [Knight of the Willblade]

Abilities

Rather than blasting enemies with magic or engaging them in melee combat, Strix Titans are their own weapons, like a kamikaze bomber. The invoking Seeker uses Strix much like a Raypulse, directing them at a target, but unlike a standard blast power, Strix are able to maneuver around obstacles and track their target for great distances. Upon impact, Strix Titans ignite in an explosion of magical energy, often destroying even the most powerful Titans. The only way to stop these heat-seeking Titans is to destroy them before they make impact, but doing so is not easy, as Strix are fast, agile, and small.

Design History

Strix is a horrible flying insect Titan with a long sting that he uses to hit his enemies when moving at top speed. The idea was that a Seeker could summon a swarm of Strix Titans, and though individually they are very weak, together they can defeat a much stronger Titan. The early sketch shows Strix looking a lot like a mosquito, with a small head and a long skinny body. Over time, this changed to a fatter body and shorter neck so it would be easier to see on the television. It also has a stinger on its tail as well as its long tongue, so a Strix is dangerous on both ends! [Huntik.com]
